room_types_guests.name: room_types_guests
room_types_guests.value: "room_types"."base_occupancy" >= 1 and "room_types"."min_guests" >= 1 and ("room_types"."max_guests" is null or ("room_types"."max_guests" >= "room_types"."base_occupancy" and "room_types"."max_guests" >= "room_types"."min_guests")) and ("room_types"."max_adults" is null or "room_types"."max_adults" >= 1)

booking_items_kind.name: booking_items_kind
booking_items_kind.value:
("booking_items"."kind" = 'stay' and "booking_items"."room_type_id" is not null and "booking_items"."offering_id" is null)
        or ("booking_items"."kind" = 'offering' and "booking_items"."offering_id" is not null and "booking_items"."slot_id" is not null and "booking_items"."room_type_id" is null)

offers_discount.name: offers_discount
offers_discount.value: ("offers"."discount_kind" = 'none' and "offers"."discount_value" is null) or ("offers"."discount_kind" = 'percent' and "offers"."discount_value" between 1 and 100) or ("offers"."discount_kind" = 'amount' and "offers"."discount_value" > 0)

offers_dates.name: offers_dates
offers_dates.value: "offers"."ends_on" is null or "offers"."starts_on" is null or "offers"."ends_on" >= "offers"."starts_on"
